text:
maya: FYI pushed PR https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/7999 — microbatch allocator tweak + fallback routing. Canary shows a p95 bump on 4k longseqs, need quick eyes.
alejandro: can you paste the bench numbers and commit hash? linking the artifact helps.
maya: commit 8f3c2d4, bench run: 1000 iters on g5. p50 42ms -> 44ms, p95 152ms -> 157ms (+3.3%), p99 280ms -> 295ms (+5.4%). memory resident +60MB on longseq. artifacts: https://ci.internal/builds/7999/artifacts/bench.zip
sophie: thanks — is this only on longseq or small-batch too?
maya: small-batch (<=128 tokens) is flat. it's the longseq tiling/horizon path that regresses. suspect kv-shard placement + extra copy in the new alloc path.
jamal: can you run with quant-kernel disabled and the old allocator on a quick compare? if delta disappears that's telling.
maya: yup queued a quick run, attaching logs once done.
ci-bot: canary deploy started for pr-7999 (canary-group A).
alejandro: also please include the heatmap and per-shard alloc counters — helps separate scheduling vs runtime kernel mix.
maya: paste of the key lines from bench summary: 
```
model: redwood-v2-4k
config: microbatcher=horizon-tiling, alloc=new
iters: 1000
p50_old: 42.0ms p50_new: 44.1ms
p95_old: 151.9ms p95_new: 157.0ms
p99_old: 279.5ms p99_new: 295.2ms
mem_old: 3.1GB mem_new: 3.16GB
alloc_churn_events: 134 -> 218
```
\nryan: if new path increases churn that explains tail. do we have an easy revert toggle to test throughput vs mem tradeoff?
maya: yes there's a runtime flag `--alloc-backoff=legacy` that reverts the placement heuristic. running that now.
sophie: if the legacy flag removes the bump can we ship a canary config that locks longseqs to legacy while we debug?
jamal: +1 for conservative canary config. we want no customer-facing regressions.
maya: quick results with `--alloc-backoff=legacy`: p95 back to 152ms, mem diff gone. so placement change is the likely culprit. full logs: https://ci.internal/builds/7999/legacy-compare.log
alejandro: nice repro. recommendation: revert the placement heuristic for rollout and keep the microbatcher changes if they don't affect small-batch. can you open a follow-up PR that gates placement behind a runtime flag and add a test?
maya: will open PR 8001 with the gate + test, and update canary to use legacy placement for longseq routes.
ryan: do we need 2nd + approvals on 7999 to merge the rest (microbatcher) or do we hold until 8001 is merged?
sophie: prefer to split: merge safe microbatch changes now, hold placement roll-forward. if 7999 is big combine, we should split.
maya: I'll split tonight and ping. for now, can I get quick 👍 from @alejandro and @ryan on merging the microbatch parts?
alejandro: eyeballing diffs now. will +1 if tests green.
ryan: I'll run a perf smoke locally and give a +1 if canary doesn't regress further.
ci-bot: canary run completed: 7999-canary-A: 1 failure (tail p99) — details: https://ci.internal/builds/7999/canary-report.html
maya: thanks — pushing split PRs and will update this thread with the split PR numbers and artifacts. ping me for followups. :wave:
